notes.title: SECRET KINKS: DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39755770/65f767261d3dab6ad8d768abb226c05d84c9ef21.jpg
Hello Lewd Tribe,
I'm glad to announce (after a very long time and a lot of delay) the demo of Secret Kinks, a game made as a team with 4 other people.
It's the first time I make a project with a lot of people, I hope you will enjoy it and send me your feedback so we can improve the game planned for Q3 2025 !

 Check the Steam page.
 Play the demo!
 Wishlist the game if you like it! 


The demo is quiet short but I will make the week 2 available in the demo as well when it will be ready (soon™️).
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391670/Secret_Kinks/
